# Kentavr

> A digital archive of the Russian methodological and game-practice almanac Kentavr (1990–2007).

## About
40 issue scan folders, 2,819 JPG files and 40 Russian Markdown issue texts.
Texts have YAML metadata and HTML page comments.

- Maintainer: Maxim Osovsky — https://www.linkedin.com/in/osovsky/
- URL: https://github.com/maximosovsky/kentavr
- Access: GitHub authorization is required while the repository is private.
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
- Source: Electronic Library on Methodology — https://www.kentavr.mathedu.ru/
